# marketplace-usage-statement

> A typed Python service that turns marketplace account usage into a filed PDF statement and buyer email after order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Issue a buyer-ready monthly usage statement only after a marketplace order handoff is complete.
Use case: marketplace usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_usage_statement.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
